slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the goal of the assignment — is it to minimize the total transportation cost (sum of flow times unit cost over all factory-location pairs), or is there a different objective (e.g., maximize something, or minimize cost subject to some other constraint)?

slot_scores.name: bijection_constraint_locations
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since each factory must be assigned to exactly one location, and there are 2 factories and 2 locations, does each location also receive exactly one factory (i.e., a one-to-one assignment), or could two factories be assigned to the same location while the other location receives none?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each location must receive exactly one factory, covering the bijection constraint.
